sharingCriteriaRules.description: Gives every internal user Read on constraint-model Expression Sets (UsageType = Constraint). The first configuration-rules run on a cold org redeploys the active models as the running user and reads these records in user mode; without row access a non-admin user, such as the sales rep, fails with "Something went wrong while running configuration rules". Pricing procedures and other Expression Sets stay Private.
sharingCriteriaRules.label: RLM Constraint Models Read
